Lahore Logic · QA Engineer (Entry Level) · Lahore

We build mobile banking apps. Our QA team makes sure every release is safe to ship.

You will
- Write clear test cases from product requirements.
- Run manual tests on Android and iOS builds before each release.
- Write detailed bug reports with steps to reproduce, expected and actual results.
- Retest fixed bugs and run regression tests.
- Learn test automation with Selenium or Appium.

You have
- A degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
- Attention to detail and patience.
- Some experience testing software, in a job, internship or project.
- Good written English for bug reports.
